question: Which award did Pranab Mukherjee receive in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Ratna**__.

__
 
• **Pranab Mukherjee received Bharat Ratna in 2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pranab Kumar Mukherjee** was an Indian politician and statesman.

 
 
• He served as the 13th President of India
